findings.title: Keep negated and conditional rejection out of history
findings.reason: The new pattern accepts the finite past verb without checking its governing negation or subjunctive particle. Its bounded word gap permits не, and the terminal boundary accepts a following бы. Thus both Какой план Ada Marlow не отвергла? and Какой план отвергла бы Ada Marlow? change from planning to history. The first asks for a plan that was not rejected; the second asks about hypothetical rejection. A proposed plan is eligible in the previous planning view but is excluded by history. This is a concrete coverage regression caused by treating a verb form as affirmative actual rejection. Preserve polarity and modality before routing the construction to history, and cover these forms in the regression tests.
